verdict.rationale: OpenRouter offers only narrow, fixed-purpose rules that act automatically on events. Workspace budgets block requests once a daily, weekly, monthly or lifetime spend limit is hit. The `models` fallback list automatically retries the next model when the primary errors, is rate-limited or refuses. There is no evidence of a general rule engine where users define arbitrary triggers and actions. Missing for 10: general user-defined event-to-action rules, webhooks or event notifications, custom action types beyond blocking and fallback, and independent corroboration of automation depth.
